CONFIRMED FAQs (owner-confirmed facts. Answer these exactly when asked. Do not treat pack seeds as fact):
Q: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
A: Yes. We bring all detergents, mops, vacuums and machines. You don't need to buy anything.

Q: Are your products safe for children and pets?
A: Yes. We use non-toxic, child and pet safe detergents. Tell us about allergies when you book.

Q: How many cleaners will come?
A: One cleaner for a 1 bedroom standard clean, two for 2 and 3 bedrooms, and a team of three or more for deep, move-out and post-construction cleans.

Q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
A: No. You can leave a key with the caretaker or a neighbour. Someone should let us in and check the work at the end.

Q: How long does a carpet take to dry?
A: Usually 4 to 6 hours. Keep windows open and avoid walking on it until it is dry.

Q: Do you clean on Sundays and public holidays?
A: We work Sundays from 9 am to 3 pm. On public holidays we work by booking only.

Q: Are your cleaners vetted?
A: Yes. Every cleaner has a police certificate of good conduct, is trained by us and wears a Done and Dusted uniform.

Q: Do you offer regular weekly cleaning?
A: Yes. Weekly or fortnightly standard cleans get 10% off each visit.

Q: Do I pay a deposit?
A: For deep, move-out and post-construction cleans we take a 30% deposit to book. Standard cleans are paid after the job.

Q: Can you remove tough stains from sofas and carpets?
A: We remove most food, drink and mud stains. Old ink, dye and bleach marks may not come out fully, and we tell you before we start.

Q: How long does each job take?
A: A 1 bedroom standard clean takes about 2 to 3 hours, 2 bedrooms 3 to 4 hours and 3 bedrooms 4 to 5 hours. A deep clean takes 5 to 8 hours and a move-out clean 6 to 8 hours. Carpets take about 1 hour each, sofas about 20 minutes a seat, mattresses about 45 minutes and windows about 10 minutes each.

Q: Do you clean in Thika?
A: Yes. Thika has a KSh 1,500 travel fee, and we only take Thika jobs of 2 bedrooms and up.
